purpose: Keep V7 features independently understandable while preserving one compact static application.

runtime.failure_policy: A missing id, duplicate id or unmet dependency stops startup visibly.

plugin.owns: DOM and behavior the plugin alone may mutate.
plugin.depends_on: Earlier plugin ids required before startup.

rules: Core contains shared state, contracts and utilities, not market-specific feature logic.
A plugin must not silently overwrite another plugin's authoritative facts.
Country-specific ingestion and terminology belong in a country pack from V7.2 onward.
Production data remains same-origin and validated before publication.
Each release changes one approved feature and passes the North Star before and after.
